instruction: Implement EVERY card in this pack. Clone from clone_path; match effect_text. Use duel_helpers.h. Spells: only edit the listed .c file. Activated/permanent may need monster_effects.h / dispatcher — serialize those. Do not leave TODO bodies. One make at the end of the whole batch.

cards.effect_text: FLIP: Place 1 Spell Counter on each face-up card you can place a Spell Counter on. FLIP: Place 1 Spell Counter on each face-up card on the field that you can place a Spell Counter on.
You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 Destiny HERO - Malicious from your Deck. You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 Destiny HERO - Malicious from your Deck.
OPT: place 1 Venom Counter; cannot attack. Once per turn, you can place 1 Venom Counter on 1 monster your opponent controls. If you activate this effect, this card cannot attack during this turn.
OPT: place 2 Venom Counters; cannot attack. Once per turn, you can place 2 Venom Counters on 1 monster your opponent controls. If you activate this effect, this card cannot attack during this turn.
